headline: Study: Czechs Overpay More Than a Billion for Electricity Due to Poor Distribution Tariff | ČeskéNoviny.cz
summary: An analysis by bezDodavatele estimates Czech households may overpay more than 1.3 billion crowns a year because of unsuitable distribution tariffs. Most do not know they can choose another tariff.
why: Electricity distribution tariffs set the cost structure for household and business power bills and are regulated in most European markets.
